about: Vasai West is a green, heritage-rich coastal locality on the Western Railway belt of the Mumbai Metropolitan Region, home to the historic Vasai Fort, Portuguese-era churches, East Indian Christian and Koli-agri villages, and the Bhuigaon and Rangaon beaches. It is served by Vasai Road junction.

faq.question: What is Vasai West known for?
faq.answer: Vasai West is known for the historic Vasai Fort (Bassein Fort), its Portuguese-era churches and strong East Indian Christian heritage, the Bhuigaon and Rangaon beaches, lush betel-nut and banana farms, and a greener, village-and-coastal character within the Mumbai Metropolitan Region.

faq.question: What is the pin code of Vasai West?
faq.answer: Vasai West comes under pin code 401202, covering localities like Vasai Gaon, Manickpur, Parnaka, Ambadi Road and the Bhuigaon belt.

faq.question: What are the sub-areas within Vasai West?
faq.answer: The main micro-localities within Vasai West are Vasai Gaon, Manickpur, Parnaka, Ambadi Road, Killa Bunder (Fort side), Bhuigaon and Rangaon.

faq.question: What is the property price in Vasai West?
faq.answer: Property prices in Vasai West range from ₹28 lakh for a 1BHK near Parnaka/Manickpur to ₹45–65 lakh for a 2BHK in Vasai Gaon and the Ambadi Road belt, and ₹65–85 lakh for premium 2BHK/3BHK near the beach and fort side. Rental rates range from ₹7,000 to ₹16,000 per month depending on the sub-area and flat size (as of May 2026).

faq.question: How to commute from Vasai West?
faq.answer: Vasai West is served by Vasai Road junction on Western Railway, with trains to Churchgate in about 55–70 minutes and connections towards the Diva/Panvel line, plus VVMC and ST feeder buses, abundant auto rickshaws, and road links towards the Western Express Highway (NH-48) and the upcoming Virar–Alibaug Multimodal Corridor.

faq.question: Which hospitals are in Vasai West?
faq.answer: Major hospitals in and near Vasai West include Cardinal Gracias Memorial Hospital, Vasai Vikasini/Sai-style multispeciality hospitals, Riddhi Vinayak Critical Care and several VVMC and trust-run clinics serving the Vasai Gaon and Manickpur belt.

faq.question: Which schools are in Vasai West?
faq.answer: Notable schools in Vasai West include St. Francis High School (Manickpur), St. Gonsalo Garcia High School, Thomas Baptista/Annunciation schools and several CBSE and SSC schools serving the Vasai Gaon and Ambadi Road area.
